title: Table of contents
description: The sections of a long page as links, the one being read marked: a policy, a service, an article. Of the whole page, or beside a text of its own and sticky. On a phone, one line that opens the list.

schema.label: Title
schema.help: Empty: “On this page” in the language of the page.

schema.label: Text
schema.help: Its headings of the second level are the sections, the third level’s their parts. The list stands beside it on a wide screen.
